#!/bin/bash
# t440 ignored-churn CPU: one instance per build, idle then churn, cumulative CPU from ps.
set -u
cd /Users/joaofnds/code/trunk
cpu() { ps -o time= -p "$1" | awk -F'[:.]' '{ if (NF==3) print ($1*60+$2)+$3/100; else print ($1*3600+$2*60+$3)+$4/100 }'; }
for round in 1 2; do
for build in before after; do
  dir=$(mise exec -- bun scripts/drive/drive.ts launch /tmp/t440ign/trunk-$build /tmp/t440ign/r | tail -1)
  export TRUNK_DRIVE_DIR="$dir"
  mise exec -- bun scripts/drive/drive.ts rows > /dev/null
  pid=$(pgrep -f "/tmp/t440ign/trunk-$build" | head -1)
  python3 -I -c 'import time; time.sleep(5)'
  c0=$(cpu "$pid")
  python3 -I -c 'import time; time.sleep(15)'
  c1=$(cpu "$pid")
  python3 -I -c '
import time, os
d = "/tmp/t440ign/r/target/debug/deps"
end = time.time() + 15
i = 0
while time.time() < end:
    with open(os.path.join(d, f"lib{i % 40}.rmeta"), "w") as f: f.write(str(i))
    i += 1
    time.sleep(0.01)
print("writes", i)
'
  c2=$(cpu "$pid")
  mise exec -- bun scripts/drive/drive.ts quit > /dev/null 2>&1
  python3 -I -c "print('round $round $build pid $pid idle15s', round($c1-$c0,2), 's cpu, churn15s', round($c2-$c1,2), 's cpu')"
  rm -rf "$dir"
done
done
